morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整外来专名记忆，首字母大写；不拆成马来语词根或英语 mur + dock。历史拼写变体不等于马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 默多克：一种姓氏，在苏格兰及爱尔兰姓氏传统中有记录；具体人物须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Murdock, a surname recorded in Scottish and Irish naming traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang terdapat dalam tradisi penamaan Scotland dan Ireland; individu yang dirujuk ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是姓氏说明，不是 DBP 官方马来语释义。仅凭词形无法确定具体人物，也不应自动改写为 Murdoch。以下是专名的句法组合，并非已核实的高频固定搭配。姓氏来源见 [Ancestry 所载《Dictionary of American Family Names》：Murdock](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/murdock)。

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies Murdock as a Scottish and Irish variant of Murdoch. This illustrates how related surnames can retain different spellings across families. Historical relationship does not make those spellings interchangeable for an individual. In Malay text, Murdock remains a personal identifier rather than becoming a common noun with a translated meaning. [Dictionary of American Family Names via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/murdock)
